title: LeCaRDv2: A Large-Scale Chinese Legal Case Retrieval Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a legal case retrieval dataset and evaluating models for it, with the motivation of ensuring 'judicial justice and fairness'. However, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component. The mention of justice and fairness serves as a high-level motivation for the technical task rather than an explicit evaluation of ethical principles.
